capabilities: Blur files, links and search results tagged #private
Cycle between reveal-all, hover and never modes
Keep private content hidden during screen sharing
Toggle visibility via commands, hotkeys and a status bar indicator
Add a blurred, collapsible private callout
disambiguation: Does not encrypt or remove files; it only visually blurs #private content until revealed.
extras: Several features are desktop-only (screen share protection, status bar indicator), though commands also work on mobile. Styling can be customized by editing and compiling styles.scss with sass.
intentEvidence: Use that plugin if you want a more in depth configuration.
motivation: The author found the 'flickering' of Privacy Glasses when opening files too distracting, so they created a simpler version for themselves.
problem: Obsidian always displays note content in full, which exposes private notes when screen sharing or working in public.

relations.evidence: Huge thanks to Privacy Glasses for the groundwork and being licensed under MIT.
This plugin requires the obsidian plugin Supercharged Links to work

summary: Blurs files, links and search results tagged #private, revealing them on hover, and keeps them hidden during screen sharing.
